title: Sponsor Stitch Plan: Quarterly Partner Snapshot, Customer Recap Email, and Renewal Tracker
content:
Purpose:
This working doc is a compact, practical kit for CSMs and AE partners to run a 30–45 minute executive sponsor update, send a customer-facing quarterly recap email, and keep a simple renewal tracker in sync. Designed to be light and repeatable for mid-market and enterprise customers.

Notes on usage (notes to self):
- Keep the executive update under 20 minutes; send the recap email within 48 hours after the meeting.
- Use the Renewal Tracker snippet during weekly account syncs with Sales.
- Replace bold placeholders (ALL CAPS) before sending.

1) Executive Sponsor Update (30 min suggested) — Slide-free agenda for a tight conversation
- 0:00–02:30: Quick hello + agenda & alignment (confirm sponsor's top priority this quarter)
- 02:30–08:00: Key wins since last meeting (metrics + customer impact)
  - Adoption: ACTIVE_USERS / MAU trends (last 90 days)
  - Performance: 95th pct latency, avg tokens per request, cost-per-1000 tokens (compare baseline)
  - Quality: example production prompts, recent regression checks / eval summary
- 08:00–18:00: Risk & enablement (top 3 risks and mitigation asks)
  - Capacity / throughput concerns and fallback policy
  - Security / compliance open items (audit log requests, KMS onboarding)
  - Product requests and roadmap alignment (short list + owners)
- 18:00–25:00: Renewal posture & commercial signals (open asks, timeline)
  - Current contract end: CONTRACT_END_DATE
  - Usage vs committed: PERCENT_UTILIZATION
  - Signs of expansion: new teams, new API routes, embeddings growth
- 25:00–30:00: Confirm next steps, owners, and date for follow-up

Talking points & one-liners for sponsor: (copy/paste)
- "In QTR we reduced 95th-percentile latency by X% while holding per-token cost flat; that improved end-user throughput for FEATURE by Y%."
- "We caught a quality regression on the chat workflow, rolled back to MODEL-v1, and scheduled a focused eval for MODEL-v2 next week."
- "To meet your ramp target, we recommend enabling dedicated capacity on peak routes for the next 60 days to avoid throttling."

2) Customer-facing Quarterly Recap Email (send within 48 hours)
- Subject line options (pick one):
  1) "Quarterly recap + next steps for [ACCOUNT_NAME] — [QUARTER YEAR]"
  2) "[ACCOUNT_NAME] — QTR highlight: performance, wins & renewal overview"

- Email body template (replace placeholders):
  Hi [EXECUTIVE NAME],

  Thanks again for making time for our sponsor update on [MEETING DATE]. Quick recap and next steps below:

  Highlights
  - Production wins: [ONE LINE WIN — e.g., 40% faster response for recommendation API, leading to 12% lift in CTR]
  - Reliability/ops: 95th pct latency improved from A ms to B ms; error rate steady at C%
  - Cost & efficiency: Intelligent batching and prefix cache now flow on ROUTE_NAME, saving ~D% in per-token cost

  Open items & asks
  - Product: [PRIORITY FEATURE], owner: [NAME], ETA: [DATE]
  - Ops: Confirmation needed on dedicated capacity for route ROUTE_NAME by [DECISION_DATE]
  - Security: Pending SOC2 docs — we expect delivery by [DATE]

  Renewal snapshot
  - Contract end: CONTRACT_END_DATE
  - Current utilization vs commit: PERCENT_UTILIZATION
  - Recommended ask: [OPT-IN TO DEDICATED / RENEW AT SAME TIER / CONSIDER 20% EXPANSION]

  Next steps
  - I'll follow up with the detailed playbook and the renewal options by [FOLLOWUP_DATE]. Please let me know if you'd like a short stakeholder review with finance included.

  Best,
  [CSM NAME] / Redwood Inference

3) Simple Renewal Tracker (text table to paste into Google Sheets or use as quick reference)
- Format header: Account | Contract End | Commit $/mo | Current $/mo | Util% | Renewal Rep | Renewal Zone | Next Decision Date | Notes
- Example rows (keep in sync with Salesforce / JIRA):
  ACME-INC | 2026-06-30 | $45,000 | $38,500 | 85% | Priya Kapoor | at-risk | 2026-05-15 | Requested dedicated capacity pilot
  NOVA-TECH | 2026-09-15 | $12,000 | $6,200 | 51% | Diego Alvarez | expansion | 2026-08-01 | Embeddings pilot for Search team
  LUMA-SOFT | 2026-03-31 | $78,000 | $80,500 | 103% | Samir Rao | upsell | 2026-02-15 | Exceeded commit; discuss tier bump

4) Playbook: Mitigations & ask scripts for common renewal scenarios
- If utilization well below commit (<=60%):
  - Ask script: "We see runway to right-size without impacting production. Can we schedule a quick usage review with your finance manager to align on commit vs. billing cadence?"
  - Operational step: Propose 3 options: (a) reduce commit by X%, (b) move to seasonal burst top-up, (c) keep commit and propose expansion credits.
- If over-utilizing (>100%):
  - Ask script: "Congrats on the usage growth — to avoid throttles we recommend either increasing committed capacity or enabling a cost-capped burst tier. Which should we model for you?"
  - Operational step: Fast path quote (need exec approval) + temporary dedicated capacity enablement for 30 days.
- If renewal undecided and exec asks for more proof:
  - Ask script: "We can run a 30-day ROI pilot focused on the top 3 routes that drive value; we'll instrument conversion metrics and share a onepager for finance."
  - Operational step: Setup pilot SOW; assign Solutions Eng; schedule weekly checkpoints.

5) Action items checklist (to run after the sponsor meeting)
- Send recap email within 48 hours (owner: CSM)
- Update Renewal Tracker (owner: Renewal Rep)
- Open Jira/Confluence tasks for product asks and tag owner (owner: CSM)
- Schedule decision review (owner: AE + Finance)
- If pilot needed, spin up Solutions Eng ticket and assign SE lead

6) Quick references & templates (copyable snippets)
- One-line expansion pitch: "If you expand to cover SEARCH and RECS routes we can reduce per-token cost by X% and guarantee 95th pct latency under Yms for peak traffic."
- Short pilot SOW bullet: 30 days, routes: ROUTE_LIST, metric targets: latency < Yms, availability 99.5%

Open questions / TODOs (authorial notes):
- Add a one-pager price band for temporary dedicated capacity options (pricing team)
- Confirm exact field names to sync with SFDC (Renewal Rep -> renewal_rep custom field)
- Create canned dashboards in Console for the three most common exec asks (latency, cost, embeddings volume)

Ownership & versioning
- Owner: Maya Chen, Customer Success (mchen@redwood.ai)
- Last updated: 2026-03-05 (draft)
- This doc is intended to be a living template — when used, copy to the account-specific folder and update tracker row.

End of kit.
